benchmark_evidence.observed: Custom objects extend the standard customer data model.
Forecast hierarchy, access permissions, quotas, configuration and drilldowns.

capabilities.foundly_current: Existing customer, lead, deal, pipeline, timeline, relationship, search and consent engines are preserved and regressions pass. CRM extensible objects and native-record field workspaces now support immutable typed schema versions, required/restricted values, current CRM relationship targets, record revisions, private/team scope, explicit access changes and archive/restore, current-source-masked history and audited export. Native contact/company/person/lead/opportunity/deal/task/appointment field records require the current parent read/write permission and exact immutable parent binding; losing parent access removes their values, history and export. Field-version saves are separate explicit internal actions, and do not claim globally mandatory fields across legacy native record creation. Existing Customer 360 includes currently authorized custom relationships. Actual service and UI/native HTTP fixtures cover source/capability/session revocation, strict types and zero/false, CAS/duplicate/retry/rollback, encrypted restart, unsaved input preservation, history pagination, and 5,000-record page projection bounds. Standalone CRM passes the same encrypted custom-object/native-field flows and its declared packaging dependency closure. Frozen crm-core.js remains byte-identical. No actual browser, live provider, production deployment or measured competitive superiority is inferred. Phase 24 continues with recorded Sales amount/date scenario, hierarchy and execution gaps and the other remaining module gaps.
capabilities.gap: Extensible object and native-record field UI, strict versioned values and current row/team/field/source security now have service, UI/HTTP, encrypted restart and standalone evidence. Actual browser and measured full competitive acceptance remain unproven; globally mandatory fields across legacy native creation are not implemented.
capabilities.required_change: Complete any remaining authoritative CRM field policy and current-user workflow acceptance without replacing the frozen core; retain actual browser and comparison gates.
capabilities.foundly_differentiator: Candidate: shared Core identity, provenance and ZERO tools. Comparative superiority is not proven.
